shellCommands.command: git diff package.json; cat package.json; find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -path ./.git -prune -o -type f -print; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/

for f in pages/*.js pages/blog/*.js pages/api/posts/*.js components/AppProvider.js styles/globals.css next.config.ts tsconfig.json .gitignore; do echo "=== $f"; cat "$f"; done; echo ===; head -50 __agent_eval__/run.mjs
cd node_modules/next/dist/docs; find 01-app -iname '*migrat*' -o -iname '*app-router*' | head; ls 01-app/*; ls 01-app/03-api-reference/*

cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference; sed -n 1,200p 04-functions/fetch.md | grep -n -i -A3 'default\|revalidate' | head -60; echo ======; ls 03-file-conventions/02-route-segment-config; echo =====; grep -n -i -B2 -A12 'global-error\|reset\|unstable_retry' 03-file-conventions/error.md | head -150

cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app; grep -n -A30 '#### Page Props Helper\|### Page Props Helper\|Page props helper' -i 03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/page.md | head -50; echo ====; grep -n -i -A30 'route context helper' 03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/route.md | head -45; echo ===; grep -n -i -B3 -A20 'route segment config.*revalidate\|^### `revalidate`\|export const revalidate' 02-guides/caching-without-cache-components.md | head -60

cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference; grep -n -i '405\|not supported\|Allow' 03-file-conventions/route.md | head; echo ===; grep -n -i -B2 -A8 'metadata\|use client\|global-not-found' 03-file-conventions/not-found.md | head -80; echo; ls /workspace/node_modules/next/package.json && node -p "require('/workspace/node_modules/next/package.json').version"; curl -sS -m 5 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts/1; curl -sS -m 5 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter
cd /workspace && mkdir -p app/blog/\[id\] app/api/posts/\[id\] lib && git mv components/AppProvider.js components/AppProvider.tsx && git mv styles/globals.css app/globals.css && rmdir styles

python3 - <<'EOF'
p='lib/posts.ts'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("export function getRecentPosts(limit: number, init?: RequestInit) {","export function getRecentPosts(\n  limit: number,\n  init?: RequestInit\n): Promise<Post[]> {")
s=s.replace("export function getComments(id: string, init?: RequestInit) {","export function getComments(\n  id: string,\n  init?: RequestInit\n): Promise<Comment[]> {")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
git rm -rq pages && rm -rf pages && printf '.next/\nnext-env.d.ts\n' >> .gitignore && npx next build 2>&1 | tail -40

(npx next start -p 3123 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 4
u=http://localhost:3123
for p in / /blog /blog/5 /blog/50 /blog/99999 /nope; do printf '%-14s ' $p; curl -s -o /tmp/o.html -w '%{http_code} ' $u$p; grep -o '<title>[^<]*</title>' /tmp/o.html | head -1; done
curl -s $u/ | grep -o 'user agent: [^<]*\|rendered at: [^<]*'
echo; curl -s $u/api/posts; echo
curl -s -XPOST -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"title":"a","content":"b"}' -w ' %{http_code}\n' $u/api/posts
curl -s -XPOST -d '{}' -w ' %{http_code}\n' $u/api/posts
curl -s -w ' %{http_code}\n' $u/api/posts/7
curl -s -XPUT -d '{"title":"x"}' -w ' %{http_code}\n' $u/api/posts/7
curl -s -XDELETE -w ' %{http_code}\n' $u/api/posts/7
curl -s -XPATCH -o /dev/null -w 'PATCH %{http_code}\n' $u/api/posts/7
curl -s -i -XOPTIONS $u/api/posts/7 | grep -i '^allow\|^HTTP'
pkill -f 'next start' ; grep -i 'error\|warn' /tmp/next.log

rm 'app/blog/[id]/loading.tsx' && python3 - <<'EOF'
p='app/page.tsx'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("  title: 'Home',\n","  title: { absolute: 'Home - My Blog' },\n")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
npx next build 2>&1 | grep -i 'error\|compiled\|✓' ; (npx next start -p 3123 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 4
u=http://localhost:3123
for p in / /blog/5 /blog/99999 /blog/abc; do printf '%-14s ' $p; curl -s -o /tmp/o.html -w '%{http_code} ' $u$p; grep -o '<title>[^<]*</title>' /tmp/o.html | head -1; done
curl -s $u/ | grep -o '<meta[^>]*\(description\|og:title\|icon\)[^>]*>\|<link rel="icon"[^>]*>'
pkill -f 'next-server|next start'; true

grep -rn "next/router\|next/head\|next/document\|getServerSideProps\|getStaticProps\|getStaticPaths\|getInitialProps" --include=*.ts --include=*.tsx --exclude-dir=node_modules --exclude-dir=.next . ; npx tsc --noEmit && echo TSC OK; git status --short; git diff tsconfig.json
